body:
Sweep of `RiemannMasullo/Ch06_LocalGlobal/Sec2.lean`.

Closes #4311

**Proved:** `exists_finiteStandardThetaAverage` ((6.2.2.4), p. 299). Only the proof and private helpers changed.

**Proof.** By left invariance, the convolution ∫ f(g⁻¹x) χ(g) dμ equals χ(x) · c(f), where c(f) = ∫ f(g⁻¹) χ(g) dμ. So the map is `c.smulRight χ`. c is linear because the integrands are integrable (`finiteStandardThetaAverage_integrable` at x = 1). It is continuous because ℬ(F_v) has the finest locally convex topology (`finitePlaceSchwartz_finestTopology`, `continuous_of_finestLocallyConvex`), and a linear left inverse of the inclusion ℬ₀(v) ⊆ ℬ(F_v) extends c to all of ℬ(F_v). The argument runs in a private lemma over abstract spaces (`exists_finiteStandardThetaAverage_abstract`). Applying `obtain` to these existentials in the concrete types made elaboration run away.

New private lemmas, directly above the theorem: `exists_finiteStandardThetaAverage_factor`, `exists_finiteStandardThetaAverage_abstract`.
